title: Overture
description: One overture: a signed request for exactly one action (spec §5.1). Additional properties are allowed, and older readers ignore them (§9).

d.description: The overture's own SAID, computed over the overture object (§6.2).

u.description: A salty nonce: a qb64 128-bit salt made fresh for this overture, never a counter.

action.description: The SAID ($id) of the catalog entry for the action asked for (§8).

params.description: The action's parameters, validated against the catalog entry that action references.

prereqs.description: SAIDs of overtures that must end completed before this one is acted on (§6.5).

preconditions.description: Preconditions (§7). A key the agent does not understand passes this schema and makes the agent refuse the overture.

nonce.description: The relying party's challenge, carried unchanged as an opaque value.

purpose.description: The requester's own words for a person, saying why it asks. Never a gate.

triggeredBy.description: The overture that caused this one, and the attached message that carried it (§6.8).

evidence.description: SAIDs of the authority evidence relied on; for a GCD chain, its leaf credential's SAID.

said.description: A SAID: a qb64 Blake3, Blake2, SHA2 or SHA3 digest of 256 or 512 bits. A verifier still parses it with a CESR parser, which a pattern cannot fully do.

aid.description: A qb64 AID prefix: a basic Ed25519, ECDSA or Ed448 key, or a self-addressing digest.

dateTime.description: A time in KERI's dt form: ISO 8601 with microseconds and a UTC offset.

version.description: The Overture version, major.minor, here with major 1 (spec §9).
